items.quote: Shega offline hojjeta, kanaafuu odeefannoon kee yeroo hunda si bira jira.

items.quote: Guyyaa Itiyoophiyaa keessatti hojjachuu dandeessa, jijjiirama rakkisaa malee.

items.quote: Daldala kee wajjin guddatu platform tokko ijaarraa.

faq.title: Gaaffii Dakkisaa
faq.subtitle: Shega irratti gaaffii yaadannee deebii argadhu.

items.question: Shega offline hojjeta?
items.answer: Eeyyen, Shega offline-first hojjeti. Odeefannoon keessan hunda meeshaa keessa jira. Naannoo internet yeroo deebi'u saffisaan yeroo argama hojjechuu itti fufa.

items.question: Guyyaa Itiyoophiyaa fayyadamuu ni danda'a?
items.answer: Eeyyen, Shega guyyaa Itiyoophiyaa guutuu deegera. Guyyaa Gregorian irraa Itiyoophiyaatti dagatii. Guyyaa, gazzii fi sagantee lamaanitti ilaala.

items.question: Bakka quunnamti heddu bulchu?
items.answer: Eeyyen, karoora keetii irratti godaansaa hedduu bulchuu dandeessa.

items.question: Deebisuu fi badhaadhinaa akkam hojjeta?
items.answer: Shega odeefannoo keessan sadarkaa tokkoon hin bakka hin qabne. Bilis deebisuu ni dandeessa.

items.question: Galannoowwan akkam hojjetu?
items.answer: Ji'aan ykn ji'aa 3 galanno. Yaalii biliis 7 booda karoora filadhaa.

items.question: Karoora naanna'a ol aanaa?
items.answer: Eeyyen, karoora kee ol aanaa haala barbaachisummaa. Dandeettii haara darba.

items.question: Odeefannoon dhaabbataa nii eegama?
items.answer: Shega PIN fi biometric deeggarsa. Odeefannoo meeshaa keessa eegama.

items.question: Shega afaan hedduu deeggara?
items.answer: Eeyyen, Shega Ingiliffaa, Amaariffaa, Oromoo, Tigrignaa deeggara. Afaan barruu barreessuu salphaa jijjiira.
